title: tclean's image history and metadata against CASA
builds: release casars-imager and casars wheel of the committed revision in a private target directory, on the laptop, with the NEON FFTW
driver: tools/casa-compat/tclean_history_compare.py, on a data root staged from the NAS casatestdata with its XSym links resolved
limits: object name, image type and miscinfo INSTRUME, distance, mpiprocs, chnchnks exact; each history line of a parameter by what it means and in CASA's order; each logtable row's PRIORITY and LOCATION exact, TIME ascending MJD seconds; the same products on both sides
outcome: 7 of 7 cases pass on every product: mfs, mtmfs, cube, dirty, restart, mask and casa-then-native, where casa-rs restarts on an image CASA wrote, keeps CASA's rows and CASA's table and image tools read the result. Parameter values differ in form only: the contract gives a scalar spw or imsize as a list of one, start as text, and threshold in Jy; the driver compares what they mean.
